title: Why So Many Parents Are Opting Out of Public Schools

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175周年，帮助您理解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是纳塔利·基特罗韦，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Across the country, public schools are facing massive declines in enrollment, while the movement to use public funds for private education grows.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，公立学校正面临入学人数的大幅下降，而将公共资金用于私立教育的运动则在不断增长。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Dana Goldstein explains why so many parents are using taxpayer money to privately educate their children,
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事达娜·戈尔德斯坦解释了为什么这么多家长用纳税人的钱让孩子接受私立教育，

sentences.en: and how their choices will transform the future of American education.
sentences.zh: 以及他们的选择将如何改变美国教育的未来。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, August 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月20日，星期三。

sentences.en: Dana, you're a longtime education reporter here at The Times.
sentences.zh: 达娜，你是《时报》的一名资深教育记者。

sentences.en: You have become a reference point, I think, for a lot of people, on what is happening with schooling in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我想，对于很多人来说，你已经成为了解美国学校现状的一个参考点。

sentences.en: And you've been covering what's been described as a sea change in the way America approaches K-12 education.
sentences.zh: 你一直在报道被形容为美国对待K-12教育方式的巨变。

sentences.en: So tell me about that change.
sentences.zh: 所以，跟我讲讲这个变化吧。

sentences.en: For the longest time, the debate among policymakers was about improving public schools.
sentences.zh: 在很长的一段时间里，政策制定者之间的争论主要围绕着改善公立学校。

sentences.en: How can policymakers help public schools do a better job?
sentences.zh: 政策制定者如何帮助公立学校做得更好？

sentences.en: Do better academically for kids?
sentences.zh: 在学业上对孩子们更好？

sentences.en: Do better socially for kids?
sentences.zh: 在社交上对孩子们更好？

sentences.en: But over the past few years, I've been looking at one of the biggest shifts I've observed in almost 20 years as an education reporter.
sentences.zh: 但在过去几年里，我一直在关注我作为教育记者近20年来观察到的最大转变之一。

sentences.en: And that is because a big idea has gotten more energy than ever before.
sentences.zh: 这是因为一个宏大的理念获得了前所未有的动力。

sentences.en: And that is that instead of putting all of our efforts into making public schools better, we should be spending more money on giving parents more opportunities
sentences.zh: 那就是，我们不应该把所有的精力都放在让公立学校变得更好上，而是应该花更多的钱给家长提供更多机会，

sentences.en: to basically escape public schools to put their kids in homeschooling or private education.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是逃离公立学校，把他们的孩子送去进行在家上学或接受私立教育。

sentences.en: And what does that look like on a policy level?
sentences.zh: 这在政策层面上是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, basically, it looks like some form of a private school voucher, some way that parents can spend taxpayer dollars to send their kids to private school or to homeschool them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，基本上，它看起来像是某种形式的私立学校代金券，一种家长可以用纳税人的钱把孩子送去私立学校或在家上学的方式。

sentences.en: And over the past five years, we have doubled the number of students using some form of a private school voucher.
sentences.zh: 在过去的五年里，使用某种形式的私立学校代金券的学生人数翻了一番。

sentences.en: And now more than one million American kids are using public dollars for some form of private education.
sentences.zh: 现在，超过一百万的美国儿童正在使用公共资金接受某种形式的私立教育。

sentences.en: And this is starting to have a big impact on the public school system that we're beginning to really take a close look at this school year.
sentences.zh: 这开始对公立学校系统产生重大影响，我们在本学年开始对其进行真正的密切关注。

sentences.en: And what is it exactly?
sentences.zh: 这到底是什么？

sentences.en: What are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: So over the past few years, according to data that we've analyzed, two-thirds of traditional public schools have lost enrollment numbers.
sentences.zh: 因此，在过去的几年里，根据我们分析的数据，三分之二的传统公立学校的入学人数下降了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A lot.
sentences.zh: 很多。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there are two reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 原因有两个。

sentences.en: The first is that Americans are having fewer children than before.
sentences.zh: 首先是美国人生育的孩子比以前少了。

sentences.en: So it makes sense that if the child population is going down, public schools will lose enrollment.
sentences.zh: 所以这就说得通了，如果儿童人口在减少，公立学校的入学人数就会下降。

sentences.en: But just as that is happening, there's this explosion of school choice, which is brought on in part by the availability of these vouchers.
sentences.zh: 但就在这种情况发生的同时，学校选择权迎来了爆发，部分原因是这些代金券的普及。

sentences.en: And we are seeing a lot of growth in the private education sector and in homeschooling.
sentences.zh: 我们看到私立教育部门和在家上学领域出现了很大的增长。

sentences.en: And when a kid uses one of these vouchers to leave a public school, they take with them public money that would otherwise go to public education.
sentences.zh: 当一个孩子使用其中一张代金券离开公立学校时，他们会带走本应用于公立教育的公共资金。

sentences.en: And this has grown to the point that we're beginning to see real impacts on public schools and a major shift in how parents think about educating their children.
sentences.zh: 这种情况已经发展到我们开始看到对公立学校产生实际影响，以及家长对孩子教育观念的重大转变。

sentences.en: And that is the culmination of years of work from conservative activists and donors.
sentences.zh: 这是保守派活动人士和捐赠者多年工作的高潮。

sentences.en: Okay, let's talk about that history.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈那段历史。

sentences.en: Let's roll the tape back.
sentences.zh: 让我们把磁带倒回去。

sentences.en: How did all this start?
sentences.zh: 这一切是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: Well, vouchers are a really old idea.
sentences.zh: 嗯，代金券是一个非常古老的想法。

sentences.en: But if you go back to the 1990s, the idea was that vouchers should be available to the kids
sentences.zh: 但如果你回到20世纪90年代，当时的观点是代金券应该提供给那些

sentences.en: who maybe needed another option most, those with disabilities who were not being adequately
sentences.zh: 可能最需要其他选择的孩子，例如在公立学校系统没有得到充分服务的残疾儿童，或者划片在表现不佳学校的低收入儿童。

sentences.en: served in the public school system, perhaps low-income children who were zoned for underperforming schools.
sentences.zh: 或者划片在表现不佳学校的低收入儿童。

sentences.en: And then there was another argument that was frequently put forth, which was that if we introduced more competition into the education sector, perhaps public schools would
sentences.zh: 然后还有另一个经常被提出的论点，那就是如果我们向教育部门引入更多竞争，当被迫与私立教育展开更多竞争时，公立学校可能会有所

sentences.en: improve when forced to compete more with private education.
sentences.zh: 改善。

sentences.en: However, the sort of organizing idea behind the private school choice movement really started to shift during the COVID-19 pandemic.
sentences.zh: 然而，私立学校选择权运动背后的某种组织理念在新冠疫情期间真正开始发生转变。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: I mean, I obviously remember very well that during the pandemic, there was all of this kind of anger from parents around school closure, around masking.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我显然记得很清楚，在疫情期间，家长们对学校关闭、戴口罩有着各种各样的愤怒。

sentences.en: There was all this debate.
sentences.zh: 当时有各种各样的辩论。

sentences.en: How did that interact with this movement?
sentences.zh: 这与这场运动是如何相互作用的？

sentences.en: Remember, parents were dissatisfied on many different levels during COVID.
sentences.zh: 记住，在疫情期间，家长在许多不同的层面上都不满意。

sentences.en: We risk losing an entire generation to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们冒着因大流行而失去整整一代人的风险。

sentences.en: It could be that their schools were closed for in-person learning and they wanted them to be open.
sentences.zh: 可能是因为他们的学校关闭了线下课程，而他们希望学校开放。

sentences.en: Schools are safe!
sentences.zh: 学校是安全的！

sentences.en: Our lives have been upended.
sentences.zh: 我们的生活被打乱了。

sentences.en: It could be that their schools were open and they thought that that wasn't cautious enough.
sentences.zh: 也可能是因为他们的学校开学了，而他们认为这还不够谨慎。

sentences.en: Putting critical race theory into our classrooms is taking our nation in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 将批判性种族理论引入我们的课堂正把我们的国家带向错误的方向。

sentences.en: Some parents watching their students learn virtually on video from home did not like what they saw.
sentences.zh: 一些家长在家通过视频虚拟观看学生学习，他们对看到的一切并不满意。

sentences.en: Or they may have just thought, look, I don't think the teacher is teaching my child effectively.
sentences.zh: 或者他们可能只是觉得，听着，我认为这位老师没有有效地教导我的孩子。

sentences.en: But all of this frustration and angst about schooling that really came to the fore during the COVID-19 pandemic sort of supercharged what many conservatives had been
sentences.zh: 但在新冠疫情期间真正浮出水面的对学校教育的所有这些挫折和焦虑，某种程度上给许多保守派一直在

sentences.en: fighting for, which was a much more universal view of the school voucher.
sentences.zh: 争取的目标注入了强心剂，那就是对学校代金券更普遍的看法。

sentences.en: So through a combination of grassroots activism and support from conservative donors and
sentences.zh: 因此，通过基层活动人士的动员以及保守派捐赠者和

sentences.en: philanthropists, a string of Republican-leaning states during the COVID-19 pandemic start to pass laws for something called a universal education savings account.
sentences.zh: 慈善家的支持，在新冠疫情期间，一连串倾向共和党的州开始通过一项名为“全民教育储蓄账户”的法律。

sentences.en: It is a type of voucher that's available to almost anybody.
sentences.zh: 这是一种几乎任何人都可以使用的代金券。

sentences.en: Very few restrictions on income.
sentences.zh: 对收入的限制极少。

sentences.en: And there are now policies like this in 18 Republican-leaning states.
sentences.zh: 目前有18个倾向共和党的州制定了这样的政策。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: A debate is raging at the state capitol over universal school vouchers.
sentences.zh: 州议会正在围绕全民学校代金券展开激烈的辩论。

sentences.en: We see states like West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了像西弗吉尼亚州这样的州。

sentences.en: Here, kids are not trapped in failing schools.
sentences.zh: 在这里，孩子们不会被困在失败的学校里。

sentences.en: Arizona.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州。

sentences.en: Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: Parents, you're in charge of your kids' education.
sentences.zh: 家长们，你们掌控着孩子的教育。

sentences.en: And most recently, Texas.
sentences.zh: 最近的是得克萨斯州。

sentences.en: Embrace this vision of a universal or near-universal education savings account.
sentences.zh: 拥抱这种全民或准全民教育储蓄账户的愿景。

sentences.en: And we want to, as you know, we want to bring education back to the states.
sentences.zh: 正如你所知，我们希望将教育权交还给各州。

sentences.en: And most recently, we even see a federal program that will be a form of private school choice, potentially nationally for the first time.
sentences.zh: 最近，我们甚至看到一个联邦项目，它将成为私立学校选择权的一种形式，这在全国历史上可能是第一次。

sentences.en: With the one big, beautiful bill, we're delivering both empowering hundreds of thousands of families
sentences.zh: 通过这项宏伟而美好的法案，我们正在实现双赢，赋能成千上万的家庭

sentences.en: to choose the public, private, charter, religious school, or the homeschool of their choice.
sentences.zh: 去选择他们心仪的公立、私立、特许学校、教会学校或在家上学。

sentences.en: And on July 4th, when President Trump signed his budget bill, included in there was a tax credit that would go to fund private school vouchers, potentially across the country.
sentences.zh: 在7月4日，当特朗普总统签署他的预算法案时，其中包含了一项税收抵免，用于资助私立学校代金券，这可能会在全国范围内实施。

sentences.en: When we look at the programs passed in the Republican states, how much money are they giving parents?
sentences.zh: 当我们审视共和党各州通过的项目时，他们给了家长多少钱？

sentences.en: The vouchers are getting more generous as this movement becomes more popular.
sentences.zh: 随着这项运动越来越受欢迎，代金券也变得越来越慷慨。

sentences.en: It could be $5,000.
sentences.zh: 可能是5000美元。

sentences.en: Also, it could be $7,000, $8,000.
sentences.zh: 此外，可能是7000美元、8000美元。

sentences.en: It could be $10,000.
sentences.zh: 可能是10000美元。

sentences.en: And for some students with disabilities, it could be up to $30,000 per year.
sentences.zh: 对于一些残疾学生，每年甚至可高达30000美元。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And often the laws are written to really include a broad variety of expenses.
sentences.zh: 通常这些法律的条文写得很广，涵盖了各种各样的开支。

sentences.en: So, for example, I could pay for traditional private school tuition, but it can also be spent on a computer that your child would use to do their homeschooling from home.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，我可以支付传统的私立学校学费，但它也可以用来买一台电脑，让你的孩子在家用于在家上学。

sentences.en: Or it could be spent on the test fee to take the SAT or an advanced placement exam.
sentences.zh: 或者它可以用来支付参加SAT考试或大学先修课程考试的考试费。

sentences.en: And I'd imagine when you're multiplying that, whatever, $5,000, $6,000, $7,000 by many, many kids,
sentences.zh: 我想当你把这些乘以，比如说，5000、6000、7000美元，乘以许许多多的孩子时，

sentences.en: at the end of the day, you're talking about a lot of money coming out of public budgets.
sentences.zh: 说到底，你谈论的是从公共预算中流出的大笔资金。

sentences.en: Yes, a lot of money coming out of state budgets for these programs and a lot of debate about whether this is a good use of public dollars.
sentences.zh: 是的，有大量资金从这些项目的州预算中流出，并且引发了大量关于这是否是对公共资金的合理利用的辩论。

sentences.en: Let's get into that debate.
sentences.zh: 让我们深入探讨这个辩论。

sentences.en: What are the critics saying now that these voucher programs have taken hold in a larger swath of the country?
sentences.zh: 既然这些代金券项目已经在该国更广泛的地区站稳脚跟，批评者现在都在说些什么？

sentences.en: Well, there are some arguments against vouchers which are perennial and have existed for decades.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有一些针对代金券的批评是老生常谈，已经存在了几十年。

sentences.en: So, for example, they don't pay necessarily for the full price of private school tuition.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，它们不一定会支付私立学校学费的全额。

sentences.en: So, therefore, it's really mostly upper middle class and affluent families who can take advantage of these to go to many private schools.
sentences.zh: 因此，实际上主要是中产阶级上层和富裕家庭能够利用这些资金去上许多私立学校。

sentences.en: In other words, you might be able to use this money for the private education that you're already paying for out of pocket with no problem.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你可能可以用这笔钱来支付你本来就可以轻松自掏腰包的私立教育。

sentences.en: And then there's the question of accountability for private education.
sentences.zh: 然后是私立教育的问责制问题。

sentences.en: Private schools do not have to follow the same accountability rules that public schools do.
sentences.zh: 私立学校不必遵守与公立学校相同的问责规则。

sentences.en: Private schools are not required by law to educate disabled students with all the supports that they need.
sentences.zh: 法律不要求私立学校为残疾学生提供他们所需的所有支持来教育他们。

sentences.en: Private schools can reject anybody they want.
sentences.zh: 私立学校可以拒绝他们想拒绝的任何人。

sentences.en: They're not required to serve everybody.
sentences.zh: 他们不被要求服务所有人。

sentences.en: And so, all of this means that private schools are more and more taking public money but not being held to exactly the same standards.
sentences.zh: 因此，这一切意味着私立学校越来越多地拿走公共资金，却没有受到完全相同的标准的约束。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there's the major concern about the impact all of this will have on public schools.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，还有一个主要的担忧，即这一切将对公立学校产生的影响。

sentences.en: Because public schools are funded on a per-pupil basis, when a single child withdraws, they take many thousands of dollars with them.
sentences.zh: 因为公立学校是按学生人数获得资助的，当单个孩子退学时，他们会带走几千美元。

sentences.en: But the school is still open.
sentences.zh: 但学校仍然开着。

sentences.en: It still needs to maintain its HVAC system, fix the roof, pay the principal.
sentences.zh: 它仍然需要维护暖通空调系统、修理屋顶、给校长发工资。

sentences.en: Keep the lights on.
sentences.zh: 保持亮灯。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, if the school is going to remain open with fewer kids, it's going to be doing everything it needs to do with less money.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果学校要在学生更少的情况下继续开办，它就必须用更少的钱去做它需要做的一切。

sentences.en: And that is a big argument that opponents of vouchers have made for many years.
sentences.zh: 这是代金券反对者多年来一直提出的一个重要论点。

sentences.en: But what's interesting is there are new critiques as this money is increasingly being spent on homeschooling,
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，随着这些资金越来越多地被用于在家上学，出现了新的批评，

sentences.en: which is the question of, is the money being spent on truly educational purposes?
sentences.zh: 那就是这些钱是否真的被花在了教育目的上？

sentences.en: In some of the states, parents have attempted to collect reimbursements for, say, buying a trampoline,
sentences.zh: 在某些州，家长曾试图为购买蹦床等物品申请报销，

sentences.en: which they have said is part of their physical education curriculum in their homeschool.
sentences.zh: 他们声称蹦床是他们在家上学课程中体育教育的一部分。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Or visiting a theme park because they've said they took their homeschooled student on a field trip.
sentences.zh: 或者参观主题公园，因为他们说他们带在家上学的学生进行了一次实地考察。

sentences.en: So, of course, when the local media has dug into some of these receipts, they have found some examples that have provoked some outrage.
sentences.zh: 所以，当然，当当地媒体深入调查其中一些收据时，他们发现了一些引发众怒的例子。

sentences.en: So, if we set aside the trampoline purchases for a moment and just focus on the fears about how
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们暂时把购买蹦床的事放在一边，只关注关于代金券将如何影响公立教育系统以及究竟什么将取代那些面向孩子们的选择的担忧，这不再是一个理论问题了，对吧？

sentences.en: vouchers are going to impact the public education system and what actually is going to replace those options for kids, that's not a theoretical question anymore, right?
sentences.zh: 这不再是一个理论问题了，对吧？

sentences.en: This has been now in practice for years, you've told us.
sentences.zh: 你告诉过我们，这已经在实践中实行多年了。

sentences.en: So, how do you determine what the impact actually has been on the ground?
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何确定它在实地造成的实际影响是什么？

sentences.en: Great question.
sentences.zh: 问得好。

sentences.en: A lot of this is pretty new, but one place where the impacts are really visible is Florida.
sentences.zh: 其中很多都相当新，但影响真正显而易见的一个地方是佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: That's where more students than in any other state are using some form of a private school voucher.
sentences.zh: 那里有比其他任何州都多的学生在使用某种形式的私立学校代金券。

sentences.en: So, I went to Orlando, which has one of the state's largest school districts, to really see how this is playing out.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了奥兰多，这里拥有该州最大的学区之一，来真正看看这一切是如何发挥作用的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘韵。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写了游戏“连线”（Connections），这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的益智游戏之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗，我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天都创作拼字游戏（Spelling Bee）和字谜游戏（Letterboxd）。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色觉联觉（Chromesthesia）的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时，我能看见颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 纽约时报的游戏是由人们制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 从今天开始游玩。

sentences.en: Dana, you go to Florida.
sentences.zh: 达娜，你去了佛罗里达州。

sentences.en: You think this is going to be a place where you really see the impact of this because, as you said, so many parents are using these vouchers.
sentences.zh: 你认为这里将成为一个真正能看到这种影响的地方，因为如你所说，许多家长都在使用这些代金券。

sentences.en: What do you find when you get there?
sentences.zh: 当你到达那里时，你发现了什么？

sentences.en: Well, what I found is a 25 percent expected decline in the size of the incoming kindergarten class in the Orange County Public Schools in Orlando.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我发现奥兰多奥兰治县公立学校的新入学幼儿园班级规模预计将下降 25%。

sentences.en: This year?
sentences.zh: 今年？

sentences.en: Yes, for this school year, which is starting right now.
sentences.zh: 是的，就是现在正要开始的这个学年。

sentences.en: And this equals about a $28 million funding decrease.
sentences.zh: 这相当于大约 2800 万美元的资金减少。

sentences.en: So it is significant for the schools.
sentences.zh: 所以这对学校来说意义重大。

sentences.en: And what's really interesting is also what I saw with my own eyes, which is when you drive down the highway, you just see housing booming up.
sentences.zh: 真正有趣的是我亲眼所见，当你开车沿着高速公路行驶时，你会发现房屋建设蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: There's a lot of new housing construction and data shows that families are moving to Orlando in pretty significant numbers.
sentences.zh: 有大量的新住宅建设，数据表明家庭正以相当大的数量搬到奥兰多。

sentences.en: It's a popular place to live.
sentences.zh: 这是一个受欢迎的居住地。

sentences.en: And yet still, even though the Orlando area defies some of these trends in terms of a decreasing child population, the public schools are experiencing disenrollment.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，尽管奥兰多地区在儿童人口减少的趋势下表现出了一些逆势，但公立学校正经历着退学潮。

sentences.en: So there are 132 elementary schools in Orange County, and 107 of them have experienced enrollment declines.
sentences.zh: 奥兰治县有 132 所小学，其中 107 所经历了招生人数下降。

sentences.en: And so we know that the private school choice, the voucher programs in Florida, are playing a very significant role.
sentences.zh: 因此我们知道，私立学校选择权，即佛罗里达州的代金券项目，正在发挥非常重要的作用。

sentences.en: And who are all these families that are leaving the public school system?
sentences.zh: 所有这些离开公立学校系统的家庭都是些什么人？

sentences.en: What's really interesting is that it cuts across demographic divides.
sentences.zh: 真正有趣的是，它跨越了人口统计学的界限。

sentences.en: What the data shows is that schools are losing population in low-income urban neighborhoods in Orlando and also in some of the affluent suburban areas near the theme parks.
sentences.zh: 数据显示，奥兰多的低收入城市街区以及主题公园附近的一些富裕郊区的学校人口正在流失。

sentences.en: And that's what I'm finding as I go out across the country and talk to parents who are either using some form of a private school voucher or want to be.
sentences.zh: 这就是我在全国各地走访时发现的情况，我与那些正在使用某种形式的私立学校代金券或希望使用的家长们交谈。

sentences.en: They're not down-the-line Republicans in any way.
sentences.zh: 他们绝不是坚定的共和党人。

sentences.en: They really run the gamut in terms of their political identity, their race, their class, and they have a lot of different reasons for why they would like to use a voucher.
sentences.zh: 在他们的政治身份、种族、阶层方面，他们真的涵盖了各个阶层，而且他们想要使用代金券的原因也各不相同。

sentences.en: What did parents tell you about why they're opting out?
sentences.zh: 家长们对你说了些什么关于他们选择离开的原因？

sentences.en: So almost all the parents I interviewed were considering something other than their neighborhood public school.
sentences.zh: 几乎我采访的所有家长都在考虑他们社区公立学校以外的选择。

sentences.en: And many of them talked about two themes over and over again.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人一遍又一遍地谈论两个主题。

sentences.en: The first was academic rigor.
sentences.zh: 第一个是学术严谨性。

sentences.en: They wanted their children to be challenged, and they had the perception, fair or not, that their children would not be adequately challenged in public education.
sentences.zh: 他们希望自己的孩子受到挑战，并且他们有一种看法，无论公平与否，即他们的孩子在公立教育中无法得到充分的挑战。

sentences.en: And the other really big theme that came out was perceptions of safety.
sentences.zh: 另一个非常大的主题是安全感。

sentences.en: Many parents told me that, especially middle schools, they perceived as sort of out-of-control behaviorally.
sentences.zh: 许多家长告诉我，特别是在初中，他们认为学生在行为上有点失控。

sentences.en: They weren't sure their kids would be really safe and well-cared for, and they were looking for a different environment.
sentences.zh: 他们不确定自己的孩子是否真的安全并得到良好的照顾，他们在寻找一个不同的环境。

sentences.en: So in these conversations, it sounds like you're hearing parents saying, the public schools are failing my kid.
sentences.zh: 所以在这些对话中，听起来家长们在说，公立学校让我的孩子失望了。

sentences.en: Is that true?
sentences.zh: 是这样的吗？

sentences.en: Is there any way of getting at that?
sentences.zh: 有什么方法可以探究这一点吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think what the parents were saying was not exactly the public schools are failing my kid, but I fear that they will.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为家长们所表达的并不是公立学校让我的孩子失望了，而是我担心它们会这样。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to say that there's no reason to believe that this public school district in Orlando is extraordinarily bad.
sentences.zh: 我认为有必要说明的是，没有理由相信奥兰多的这个公立学区有什么特别糟糕的地方。

sentences.en: In fact, the opposite is true.
sentences.zh: 事实上，恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Seventy-five percent of the schools have an A or B rating from the state of Florida.
sentences.zh: 百分之七十五的学校获得了佛罗里达州 A 级或 B 级的评级。

sentences.en: So, of course, like any large district, there are some underperforming schools.
sentences.zh: 当然，就像任何大型学区一样，有一些表现不佳的学校。

sentences.en: There's some racial segregation within the school system and class segregation.
sentences.zh: 学校系统内部存在一些种族隔离和阶级隔离。

sentences.en: But in many ways, this is a typical large school district.
sentences.zh: 但在很多方面，这是一个典型的大型学区。

sentences.en: So when those families vote with their feet, when they take their kids out of the public system, where do they go?
sentences.zh: 因此，当这些家庭用脚投票，将他们的孩子带出公立系统时，他们去了哪里？

sentences.en: Well, first, let's talk about where they mostly aren't going.
sentences.zh: 好吧，首先，让我们谈谈他们大部分没有去的地方。

sentences.en: Because if you have a voucher worth, say, $7,000 to $10,000 per year, that is not going to buy you the cost of a really academically elite private school.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你有一张价值比如说每年 7,000 到 10,000 美元的代金券，那是买不起真正学术上一流的私立学校的学费的。

sentences.en: Of course, the vast majority of private schools in Florida and across the country are Christian or Catholic schools, and those are receiving many of these voucher dollars.
sentences.zh: 当然，佛罗里达州和全国绝大多数私立学校都是基督教或天主教学校，这些学校接收了许多这些代金券资金。

sentences.en: But what's really interesting nationally is that the private school traditional brick-and-mortar sector is not really growing to meet the new demand created by these voucher prograMs.
sentences.zh: 但全国范围内真正有趣的是，传统的实体私立学校领域并没有真正增长以满足这些代金券项目产生的新需求。

sentences.en: And so we really see a lot of growth in nontraditional private education.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实看到非传统私立教育的大幅增长。

sentences.en: Here's what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 以下是它的样貌。

sentences.en: It could be a micro-school, which is, you know, a private, for-profit, one-room schoolhouse-type model.
sentences.zh: 它可以是一个微型学校，你知道的，这是一种私营的、营利性的、单房间校舍类型的模式。

sentences.en: I have visited some of these.
sentences.zh: 我参观过其中一些。

sentences.en: It could be run out of the teacher's house.
sentences.zh: 它可以在老师的家里运营。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: It could be rented space in a strip mall.
sentences.zh: 它可以是商业街区租用的空间。

sentences.en: And it could cost $5,000 or $6,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 一年可能花费 5,000 或 6,000 美元。

sentences.en: There might be seven or 12 kids in there.
sentences.zh: 里面可能有七个或十二个孩子。

sentences.en: Another thing that's really growing is virtual schooling, which is for-profit.
sentences.zh: 另一个真正增长的事物是虚拟学校教育，这是营利性的。

sentences.en: And we see venture capital money flowing into this sector and really growing it up.
sentences.zh: 我们看到风险投资资金流入这个行业并使其真正成长。

sentences.en: But these are programs that homeschoolers often enroll in to help their parents guide them through the curriculum at home.
sentences.zh: 但这些都是在家上学者经常报名的项目，以帮助他们的父母指导他们在家学习课程。

sentences.en: So this private school market expands.
sentences.zh: 因此，这个私立学校市场在扩大。

sentences.en: People flock to it.
sentences.zh: 人们蜂拥而至。

sentences.en: How is the Orlando School District responding?
sentences.zh: 奥兰多学区是如何应对的？

sentences.en: Because this sounds like an exodus from the public system.
sentences.zh: 因为这听起来像是对公立系统的大撤离。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They are trying some really nontraditional things.
sentences.zh: 他们正在尝试一些非常非常规的做法。

sentences.en: One of the things I did while I was down there was traverse the city with a team of consultants who are from a private company that recruits students to public education.
sentences.zh: 我在那里时做的事情之一就是与一个顾问团队一起穿梭于城市中，这些顾问来自一家为公立教育招收学生的私营公司。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they're basically out there with flyers and information about the public school district.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上带着公立学区的传单和信息走出去。

sentences.en: And they're looking for parents.
sentences.zh: 他们在寻找家长。

sentences.en: It could be at a boys and girls club.
sentences.zh: 可能在青少年俱乐部。

sentences.en: They could visit a preschool, a playground.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会参观学前班、游乐场。

sentences.en: And they're saying, hey, are you considering school options for your child?
sentences.zh: 他们在说，嘿，你在为你的孩子考虑学校选择吗？

sentences.en: Let me tell you about all of the great things that are happening in Orange County public schools.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你奥兰治县公立学校正在发生的所有棒极了的事情。

sentences.en: So districts are hiring companies like this to actually market themselves, essentially.
sentences.zh: 所以学区正在聘请这样的公司来为自己做营销，本质上是这样。

sentences.en: Door-to-door salesmen for public schools.
sentences.zh: 公立学校的挨家挨户推销员。

sentences.en: It's kind of remarkable.
sentences.zh: 这真是挺了不起的。

sentences.en: What is their pitch?
sentences.zh: 他们的宣传重点是什么？

sentences.en: So they really target their pitch to what parents are looking for.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会根据家长的需求来调整宣传内容。

sentences.en: So if the mom says, you know, I work till six.
sentences.zh: 比如如果妈妈说，你知道的，我工作到六点。

sentences.en: I really need after school child care.
sentences.zh: 我真的很需要课后托儿服务。

sentences.en: They'll be prepared to talk about the after school options.
sentences.zh: 他们就会准备好谈论课后选择。

sentences.en: If the parent says, I really want my high school kid to earn college credit, they can talk about dual enrollment with the local community college or the advanced placement program.
sentences.zh: 如果家长说，我真的很想让我的高中孩子获得大学学分，他们就可以谈论与当地社区学院的双重注册项目或大学先修课程。

sentences.en: So they're really listening to what parents have to say.
sentences.zh: 所以他们真的在倾听家长的心声。

sentences.en: But they also make some anti-private school arguments that might be controversial.
sentences.zh: 但他们也提出了一些可能引发争议的反私立学校论点。

sentences.en: If a parent says, I'm looking for small class size, they will say, look,
sentences.zh: 如果家长说，我在找小班教学，他们会说，你看，

sentences.en: there's very little or no research that shows that a small class size leads to better outcomes in adulthood.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么研究表明小班教学能带来更好的成年期成果。

sentences.en: And this speaks to the fact that this is now a much more competitive marketplace.
sentences.zh: 这说明现在的市场竞争要激烈得多。

sentences.en: For a hundred years, public schools have had a near monopoly, and that has really changed in Florida.
sentences.zh: 一百年来，公立学校几乎拥有垄断地位，而在佛罗里达州，这种情况真的变了。

sentences.en: If parents are leaving public schools because they think they can do better for their kids, which is what you're hearing,
sentences.zh: 如果家长离开公立学校是因为他们认为自己能为孩子做得更好，也就是你所听到的这样，

sentences.en: do we have any insight into whether they actually are doing better for their kids?
sentences.zh: 我们是否有任何洞察，了解他们是否真的为孩子做出了更好的成绩？

sentences.en: Are their kids doing better academically?
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子在学业上表现得更好吗？

sentences.en: In other words, is the promise of school choice paying off?
sentences.zh: 换句话说，择校的承诺是否得到了兑现？

sentences.en: This is such a crucial question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个至关重要的问题。

sentences.en: And what is really frustrating for me as an education reporter is right now, there is not a strong consensus on what the answer to that question is.
sentences.zh: 作为一名教育记者，对我来说真正令人沮丧的是，目前对于这个问题的答案并没有形成强有力的共识。

sentences.en: There have been some studies of what happens after a child accepts a voucher.
sentences.zh: 有一些关于孩子接受代金券后情况的研究。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, they've come to conflicting conclusions.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，它们的结论相互矛盾。

sentences.en: One study out of Ohio seemed to suggest that kids who took a voucher did better in terms of attending and graduating from college than similar peers that didn't use a voucher.
sentences.zh: 一项来自俄亥俄州的研究似乎表明，与没有使用代金券的同类同龄人相比，使用代金券的孩子在入读和大学毕业方面表现得更好。

sentences.en: But a study from Louisiana came to a very different conclusion.
sentences.zh: 但路易斯安那州的一项研究得出了截然不同的结论。

sentences.en: It showed that students with a voucher did worse on math standardized tests.
sentences.zh: 它表明持有代金券的学生在数学标准化测试中表现更差。

sentences.en: So this is something that researchers are continuing to look at with great interest, and I'm going to be continuing to track as a reporter.
sentences.zh: 所以这是研究人员正在极具兴趣地继续研究的事情，作为一名记者，我也将继续追踪报道。

sentences.en: But to step back a second,
sentences.zh: 但退一步讲，

sentences.en: the proponents of these programs are not really making the argument that they're going to lead to higher test scores or better academic outcomes that are measurable for students.
sentences.zh: 这些项目的支持者并没有真正提出这样的论点，即它们会带来更高的考试成绩或对学生而言可衡量的更好学业成果。

sentences.en: It's much bigger than that.
sentences.zh: 这比这宏大得多。

sentences.en: They're making an argument about parental rights, about parental choice, that every family should choose for themselves what works best for their individual child,
sentences.zh: 他们提出的是关于家长权利、家长选择的论点，即每个家庭都应该为自己选择最适合其个别孩子的方式，

sentences.en: and they get to define what success looks like.
sentences.zh: 而且他们有权定义什么是成功。

sentences.en: And this is a really big philosophical shift from where education politics was in the very recent past, which was all about helping kids learn more, raising their test scores.
sentences.zh: 这与近期教育政治的立场相比是一个非常大的哲学转变，过去的政治完全关乎帮助孩子学到更多、提高他们的考试成绩。

sentences.en: In some ways, it sounds like the measure of success isn't precisely about kids' achievement per se, but whether parents are happy, which to a certain extent makes sense, right?
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，听起来成功的标准并不是精确地关于孩子本身的成就，而是家长是否高兴，从某种程度上说这也说得通，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, like, we should expect parents to want to be satisfied with the education that their children are getting.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，比如，我们应该期望家长对孩子接受的教育感到满意。

sentences.en: Yes, and I totally get that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全理解这一点。

sentences.en: I have two kids in public school, and I'm always wondering if they're being well-served and looking for more information about what's going on in their classroom and thinking,
sentences.zh: 我有两个孩子在公立学校上学，我总是想知道他们是否得到了很好的服务，并寻找更多关于他们教室里发生的事情的信息，心想：

sentences.en: are they being challenged?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有受到挑战？

sentences.en: Are their social-emotional needs being met?
sentences.zh: 他们的社交情感需求是否得到了满足？

sentences.en: But whether it's me or any other parent, we make these assessments about schools with imperfect information.
sentences.zh: 但无论是作为我还是任何其他家长，我们在信息不完善的情况下对学校做出这些评估。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a lot of rumors and gossip in a neighborhood about what's going on in a school that may or may not align with reality.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，社区里有很多关于学校里发生的事情的谣言和小道消息，这些可能与现实相符，也可能不相符。

sentences.en: And there can be a real gap between perception and reality when it comes to the quality of public education.
sentences.zh: 在公立教育质量方面，看法与现实之间确实可能存在差距。

sentences.en: Dana, I want to ask a political question here.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我想在这里问一个政治问题。

sentences.en: Given the popularity of these programs, which you've told us about and which you said cuts across demographic lines and appeals to many working-class families,
sentences.zh: 鉴于这些项目的受欢迎程度，你已经向我们介绍过，并且你说它跨越了人口统计界限，吸引了许多工人阶级家庭，

sentences.en: what are Democrats to do in this scenario?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，民主党人该怎么办？

sentences.en: Because it seems like a very tricky political situation for them.
sentences.zh: 因为对他们来说，这似乎是一个非常棘手的政治局势。

sentences.en: Because on the one hand, they don't want to alienate working-class voters who support this.
sentences.zh: 因为一方面，他们不想疏远支持这一点的工人阶级选民。

sentences.en: But on the other, it's been a core value of the Democratic Party to uphold and support the public education system.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，维护和支持公立教育系统一直是民主党的核心价值观。

sentences.en: This is an incredibly tricky emerging issue for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 对民主党人来说，这是一个极其棘手的新兴问题。

sentences.en: Polls suggest that while white liberals feel pretty negatively about private school vouchers, a lot of working-class Black and Hispanic parents are interested in them.
sentences.zh: 民意调查显示，虽然白人自由派对私立学校代金券持相当负面的看法，但许多工人阶级的黑人和西班牙裔家长对它们很感兴趣。

sentences.en: And in fact, many of the parents who I interviewed in Orlando who are excited to use a voucher were Black and Hispanic.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在奥兰多采访的许多很高兴使用代金券的家长都是黑人和西班牙裔。

sentences.en: We spoke earlier about President Trump signing into law the first sort of national federal private school choice program.
sentences.zh: 我们之前谈到过特朗普总统签署了第一项国家级联邦私立学校择校项目立法。

sentences.en: Governors will have the opportunity to opt in or out to decide if their states are going to accept that money.
sentences.zh: 各州长将有机会选择加入或退出，以决定他们的州是否接受这笔资金。

sentences.en: Now, Democratic governors are facing a really difficult choice.
sentences.zh: 现在，民主党州长们正面临着一个非常艰难的选择。

sentences.en: They're going to have a lot of pressure from constituencies like teachers' unions to not provide vouchers for private school tuition.
sentences.zh: 他们将面临来自教师工会等选民群体的巨大压力，要求不要为私立学校学费提供代金券。

sentences.en: However, they are also hearing from those within the Democratic Party who are urging a new approach,
sentences.zh: 然而，他们也听到了民主党内部呼吁采取新方法的呼声，

sentences.en: one that would tune into the fact that working-class Black and Hispanic parents, those same voters who we know tilted toward President Trump in last year's election,
sentences.zh: 这种方法将注意到这样一件事：工人阶级的黑人和西班牙裔家长，也就是我们知道在去年大选中倾向于特朗普总统的那些选民，

sentences.en: are excited about school choice.
sentences.zh: 对择校感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And if even a single Democratic governor chooses to participate in the Trump private school scholarship program, there will be pressure on others to participate.
sentences.zh: 如果哪怕只有一个民主党州长选择参加特朗普的私立学校奖学金项目，其他人也将面临参加的压力。

sentences.en: Pulling back, I want to ask what it means to have public schools in this world where we have this system
sentences.zh: 退一步讲，我想问一下，在一个拥有这样一个系统的世界里，公立学校意味着什么：

sentences.en: that pours taxpayer dollars into vouchers that funnel people into private schools.
sentences.zh: 这个系统将纳税人的钱投入代金券中，将人们输送到私立学校。

sentences.en: There are practical implications that we've talked about, but what I want to know is, as a country, what does it mean about how we see now the function of education in America?
sentences.zh: 我们已经讨论过一些实际影响，但我想知道的是，作为一个国家，这意味着我们现在如何看待美国教育的功能？

sentences.en: So I think this gets to some of the deepest ideological divides in our country.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这触及了我们国家最深层的意识形态分歧。

sentences.en: If you see education as an issue of parental empowerment and parental rights, you are going to love the moment we're in with the expansion of vouchers and private school choice.
sentences.zh: 如果你将教育视为家长赋权和家长权利的问题，你会喜欢我们现在所处的代金券和私立学校择校不断扩大的时代。

sentences.en: However, it's worth pointing out that this is in deep contradiction to some of the sort of fundamental founding principles of public education in the United States.
sentences.zh: 然而，值得指出的是，这与美国公立教育的一些基本建国原则存在深刻的矛盾。

sentences.en: If you go back to the 1830s and the birth of the common schools movement and a man named Horace Mann, who was sort of the father of public education in America,
sentences.zh: 如果你追溯到19世纪30年代以及公立学校运动的诞生，还有霍勒斯·曼这样一个人，他可以说是美国公立教育之父，

sentences.en: his idea was that you would take children across lines of difference, religion, class,
sentences.zh: 他的想法是，你将跨越不同阶层、宗教、阶级的儿童聚集在一起，

sentences.en: later on, of course, race being a crucial line of difference that we're supposed to cross in the classroom, bring all these kids together and inculcate in them shared values,
sentences.zh: 当然，后来种族也是我们应该在课堂上跨越的关键差异线，把所有这些孩子聚在一起，向他们灌输共同的价值观，

sentences.en: prepare them together across differences for citizenship in a democracy, make sure that our future voters and future workers have great reading comprehension skills.
sentences.zh: 跨越差异为他们将来在民主社会中成为公民做好准备，确保我们未来的选民和未来的工人具备出色的阅读理解能力。

sentences.en: Now, as a country, did we live up to these beautiful ideals?
sentences.zh: 现在，作为一个国家，我们是否不辜负了这些美好的理想？

sentences.en: Often, we did not.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，我们没有。

sentences.en: Often, we kept kids in schools that were segregated by race and class.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，我们将孩子留在按种族和阶层隔离的学校里。

sentences.en: Often, kids graduated without great reading skills, without great math skills.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，孩子毕业时没有出色的阅读技能，没有出色的数学技能。

sentences.en: And there has been a lot of cynicism about public education.
sentences.zh: 公众对公立教育一直存在很多玩世不恭的态度。

sentences.en: But many people still hold fast to these ideals of common schooling.
sentences.zh: 但许多人仍然坚守这些共同学校教育的理想。

sentences.en: However, the private school choice movement is moving so quickly that it is worth pausing to consider
sentences.zh: 然而，私立学校择校运动发展得如此之快，以至于值得停下来思考一下，

sentences.en: whether education in America could look drastically different within our lifetimes.
sentences.zh: 在我们的有生之年，美国的教育是否会发生翻天覆地的变化。

sentences.en: Well, Dana, thanks so much for coming on the show.
sentences.zh: 好的，达娜，非常感谢你来参加节目。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: White House Press Secretary Caroline Leavitt said on Tuesday that President Vladimir Putin of Russia had agreed to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky,
sentences.zh: 白宫新闻秘书卡罗琳·莱维特周二表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京已同意与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基会面，

sentences.en: something Moscow hasn't confirmed.
sentences.zh: 莫斯科方面尚未证实这一点。

sentences.en: Trump has touted the potential meeting between the two leaders as an achievement of Monday's Day of Diplomacy with European leaders,
sentences.zh: 特朗普将两国领导人潜在的会晤吹捧为周一与欧洲领导人“外交日”的一项成果，

sentences.en: who visited Washington to discuss terms for ending the war in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这些欧洲领导人访问了华盛顿，讨论结束乌克兰战争的条款。

sentences.en: But the Kremlin downplayed any potential for face-to-face peace talks.
sentences.zh: 但克里姆林宫淡化了面对面和平会谈的任何可能性。

sentences.en: Russian state media barely mentioned any possibility of Putin and Zelensky sitting down together on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯官方媒体周二几乎没有提及普京和泽连斯基坐在一起交谈的任何可能性。

sentences.en: And Russia's foreign minister said that while Russia wasn't against such a meeting, any contacts involving top officials would have to be prepared very carefully.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯外长表示，虽然俄罗斯并不反对这样的会晤，但涉及高级官员的任何接触都必须经过非常仔细的筹备。

sentences.en: World leaders have been trying to hammer out security guarantees to protect a post-war Ukraine, including potentially sending European soldiers to the country as peacekeepers.
sentences.zh: 世界领导人一直在努力敲定安全保证，以保护战后的乌克兰，包括可能向该国派遣欧洲士兵作为维和人员。

sentences.en: Trump has said American troops would not be sent to Ukraine as part of any deal.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾表示，作为任何协议的一部分，美国军队都不会被派往乌克兰。

sentences.en: I just want to end it.
sentences.zh: 我只是想结束它。

sentences.en: I want to end it.
sentences.zh: 我想结束它。

sentences.en: You know, we're not losing American lives.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们没有在损失美国的生命。

sentences.en: We're not losing American soldiers.
sentences.zh: 我们没有在损失美国的士兵。

sentences.en: We're losing Russian and Ukrainian, mostly soldiers.
sentences.zh: 我们损失的主要是俄罗斯和乌克兰士兵。

sentences.en: And in an interview on Fox & Friends on Tuesday, the president gave new insight into his efforts to broker an end to the war.
sentences.zh: 周二，在接受《福克斯与朋友们》节目采访时，总统透露了他为斡旋结束战争所做努力的新细节。

sentences.en: You know, if I can save 7,000 people a week from being killed, I think that's a pretty—I want to try and get to heaven if possible.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我能每周拯救7000人不被杀害，我认为这挺——如果可能的话，我想尽量上天堂。

sentences.en: I'm hearing I'm not doing well.
sentences.zh: 我听说我表现得不太好。

sentences.en: I am really at the bottom of the totem pole.
sentences.zh: 我在社会底层垫底呢。

sentences.en: But if I can get to heaven, this will be one of the reasons.
sentences.zh: 但如果我能上天堂，这将是原因之一。

sentences.en: Well, I think I saved a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我拯救了很多人。

sentences.en: He said his motivation was salvation.
sentences.zh: 他说他的动机是为了寻求救赎。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Eric Krupke and Diana Nguyen, with help from Sidney Harper and Mary Wilson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由埃里克·克鲁普克和戴安娜·阮制作，西德尼·哈珀和玛丽·威尔逊提供协助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lexi Diao and M.J.
sentences.zh: 节目由莱克西·迪奥和M.J.

sentences.en: Davis-Lynn, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩编辑，克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为您准备节日期间的待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
